author: ZackyLake
title: GPU unit tests fail to extract OpenVINO package - tbb12.dll locked (Access denied) on Windows self-hosted runner
signature: remove item cannot remove item access to the path is denied unauthorizedaccessexception|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: GPU unit tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Extract OpenVINO packages step fails: Expand-Archive -Force cannot overwrite tbb12.dll because it is locked, PowerShell throws UnauthorizedAccessException.

key_errors: 2026-11-18T06:56:13.7886247Z Access to the path 'C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\install\runtime\3rdparty\tbb\bin\tbb12.dll' is denied.
root_cause: The 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step runs Expand-Archive -Force against the persistent C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\install directory on a self-hosted Windows GPU runner. Expand-Archive's -Force cleanup attempts to delete the pre-existing tbb12.dll before re-extracting it from the new openvino_package.zip, but the DLL is still memory-mapped/held open by a lingering process (likely an orphaned test or driver process from a previous job on the same persistent runner), so Remove-Item throws UnauthorizedAccessException and the step exits with code 1. PR #39991 only touches CPU-impl event-generation code under src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/impls/cpu/ and a unit test file; none of these changes affect artifact extraction or the runner's workspace, so this is unrelated to the PR's content.
reproduction_steps: N/A - requires reproducing a stale file lock on a specific Windows self-hosted GPU runner across consecutive job runs; not reproducible deterministically via a clean local checkout.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'GPU unit tests' job; the lock typically clears once the holding process exits.
Have runner/infra investigate what process keeps tbb12.dll open between consecutive jobs on this Windows self-hosted GPU runner pool (e.g. orphaned test process, antivirus scan).
Wrap Expand-Archive -Force (or the preceding cleanup) with a retry-with-delay loop so a transient lock does not immediately fail the step.
Consider extracting into a fresh per-run directory instead of overwriting a persistent install/ path shared across runs on the same self-hosted runner.
prevention_strategies: Add workspace hygiene steps (kill orphaned OpenVINO/test processes, clear the install/ directory) at the start or end of each GPU-runner job rather than relying on Expand-Archive -Force to clobber locked files in place.
historical_context: This exact signature (95bb23aa2ed8a84d) has now recurred 15 times since 2026-11-09, including twice in the last 12 hours (runs 44205432885 at 06:32 and 44229399112 at 06:46 UTC on 2026-11-18), making this the 3rd occurrence within the 12-hour window - triggering the recurring escalation. A rerun_search_string candidate for this signature was previously proposed in PR #39664 but was closed/rejected by a maintainer on 2026-11-10, so no new proposal is made here.
